newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close higher, helped by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close higher, helped by Wall Street.

text.p: French shares closed higher on Monday as September futures contracts expired during a bullish spell encouraged by an early rise on Wall Street.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 25.76 points or 1.22 percent at 2,132.81 while the CAC-40 futures contract rose 19 points to 2,135. Volume was a heavy 6.36 billion francs.
Shares in Eurotunnel were suspended at the company's request as talks between the Channel Tunnel operator and its creditor banks went down to the wire.
Eurotunnel is seeking to refinance $14 billion of debt.
Shares in Alcatel Alsthom extended their recent rise, closing up 1.28 percent, on last week's first half results and a positive perception by analysts of the company's outlook and plans.

Bank Societe Generale's stock fell 1.04 percent to 571 francs after U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch downgraded its rating on the share to "neutral" from "accumulate" because of the bank's interest in soon-to-be-privatised CIC.
